description: Disposition of the numbered rules of the earlier regex converter (compiler/parser/st-to-rusty-converter/scripts/dialect_rules.py on main) and of constructs it did not cover. Each entry carries a check that the pinned RuSTy must confirm: 'accepted' means the original form already compiles, so no rule is needed; 'rejected' lists the expected error codes; 'handled_by' names the rule (with its own probe) or the unsupported construct that takes over. Corpus counts are occurrences in code (not comments) of artifacts/intake/extract/outputs.

entries.name: SET -> SET0
entries.reason: SET is not a RuSTy keyword; the identifier compiles unchanged
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR SET : BOOL; END_VAR
SET := TRUE; f := 1;
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: OVERRIDE -> _OVERRIDE
entries.reason: OVERRIDE is a RuSTy keyword but not a CODESYS one; the rule renames it consistently with a collision-free suffix, only where E007 reports it
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR OVERRIDE : BOOL; END_VAR
OVERRIDE := TRUE; f := 1;
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: POINTER TO -> REF_TO
entries.reason: RuSTy accepts POINTER TO; keeping it also keeps byte arithmetic under --byte-pointer-arithmetic (patch 0003), which REF_TO would lose
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR p : POINTER TO INT; x : INT; END_VAR
p := ADR(x); f := p^;
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: ADR() -> REF()
entries.reason: changes meaning: arithmetic on REF() is scaled by the element size, CODESYS ADR() arithmetic counts bytes (principle 3); RuSTy accepts ADR()
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR p : POINTER TO INT; x : INT; END_VAR
p := ADR(x); f := p^;
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: Remove VAR_INPUT CONSTANT
entries.reason: still rejected; the rule keeps CONSTANT as a comment instead of deleting it
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR_INPUT CONSTANT a : INT; END_VAR
f := a;
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: Array size UINT -> ULINT
entries.reason: changes a parameter type (principle 3) and was OSCAT specific; the pinned RuSTy accepts SIZEOF() passed to a UINT parameter, and the OSCAT intake needs no library-level replacement
entries.source:
FUNCTION g : INT
VAR_INPUT size : UINT; END_VAR
g := UINT_TO_INT(size);
END_FUNCTION
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR a : ARRAY[0..3] OF INT; END_VAR
f := g(size := SIZEOF(a));
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: Array init with []
entries.reason: still rejected; the rule works on the token stream instead of a regex over the line
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR a : ARRAY[0..2] OF INT := 1, 2, 3; END_VAR
f := a[1];
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: STRING() -> STRING[]
entries.reason: RuSTy accepts STRING(n) and WSTRING(n)
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR s : STRING(20); w : WSTRING(10); END_VAR
s := 'ab'; f := LEN(s);
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: FUNCTIONBLOCK -> FUNCTION_BLOCK
entries.reason: the pinned RuSTy accepts the FUNCTIONBLOCK header (warning E013: the words should be separated by '_'); only its END_FUNCTIONBLOCK terminator is rejected, which end-functionblock-keyword handles
entries.source:
FUNCTIONBLOCK fb
VAR x : INT; END_VAR
x := 1;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

entries.name: END_FUNCTIONBLOCK terminator
entries.reason: rejected (RuSTy reports the following units); FUNCTIONBLOCK is the CODESYS keyword retired by C0098, END_FUNCTIONBLOCK its terminator; rewritten only where it closes a function block. 0 occurrences in code, so the rule is last in the CODESYS profile
entries.source:
FUNCTION_BLOCK fb
VAR x : INT; END_VAR
x := 1;
END_FUNCTIONBLOCK

entries.name: TOD HH:MM -> TOD HH:MM:SS
entries.reason: RuSTy accepts TOD#hh:mm

entries.name: Function call [] -> ()
entries.reason: still rejected (E059), but no collected vendor manual defines calls with brackets and the corpus has 0 occurrences; reported, not rewritten
entries.source:
FUNCTION g : INT
VAR_INPUT a : INT; END_VAR
g := a;
END_FUNCTION
FUNCTION f : INT
f := g[a := 1];
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: METHOD -> FUNCTION
entries.reason: RuSTy supports METHOD, INTERFACE and PROPERTY natively; a METHOD is not a free FUNCTION. What remains is reassembling methods, properties and actions that exports place after the FB body
entries.source:
FUNCTION_BLOCK fb
VAR x : INT; END_VAR
METHOD m : INT
m := x;
END_METHOD
x := 1;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

entries.name: Add missing END_*
entries.reason: inserting a terminator guesses where the POU ends (principle 4); a truncated POU is reported
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
f := 1;

entries.name: ENDIF identifier -> ENDIF0
entries.reason: generalized: the dialect profiles list the compact END* spellings that RuSTy reserves (identifier_words); renamed consistently where E007 reports them
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR ENDIF : INT; END_VAR
ENDIF := 1; f := ENDIF;
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: STRING_LENGTH -> 255
entries.reason: RuSTy resolves global constants in STRING lengths; inlining 255 changed the value (OSCAT declares its own constant). The OSCAT-specific part, taking the missing global constants from the 2.3 export of the same release, is library-level configuration (normalize/libraries/oscat-basic-335-codesys3.json)
entries.source:
VAR_GLOBAL CONSTANT STRING_LENGTH : INT := 254; LIST_LENGTH : INT := 254; END_VAR
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR s : STRING[STRING_LENGTH]; l : STRING[LIST_LENGTH]; END_VAR
s := 'ab'; f := LEN(s);
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: LIST_LENGTH -> 255
entries.reason: as rule 15
entries.source:
VAR_GLOBAL CONSTANT LIST_LENGTH : INT := 254; END_VAR
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR l : STRING[LIST_LENGTH]; END_VAR
l := 'ab'; f := LEN(l);
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: ELSEIF -> ELSIF
entries.reason: rejected; ELSEIF is documented as the else-if clause by Emerson PACSystems ('Either ELSIF or ELSEIF can be used'), LS XGI and the B&R IF statement description. 0 occurrences in code, so the rule is last in each profile
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR_INPUT a : INT; END_VAR
IF a = 1 THEN f := 1; ELSEIF a = 2 THEN f := 2; ELSE f := 3; END_IF;
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: ENDCASE/ENDFOR/ENDWHILE/ENDREPEAT -> END_*
entries.reason: RuSTy accepts the compact terminators

entries.name: ENDTYPE/ENDSTRUCT -> END_*
entries.reason: RuSTy accepts the compact terminators
entries.source:
TYPE s : STRUCT a : INT; ENDSTRUCT ENDTYPE
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR v : s; END_VAR
f := v.a;
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: T# -> TIME#, D# -> DATE#
entries.reason: RuSTy accepts the short prefixes
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : DATE
VAR t : TIME := T#1s; END_VAR
f := D#2020-01-01;
END_FUNCTION

entries.name: Namespace call dot -> underscore
entries.reason: X.Y -> X_Y can bind to a different symbol of the library (principle 3). CODESYS library qualifiers are dropped only when the library is compiled in the same project and defines the name (library-qualifier); SIMATIC AX namespaces are flattened to the collision-free NS__Name (ax-namespace-flatten); other qualifiers stay unresolved and block intake

entries.name: ADR() arithmetic -> byte-pointer arithmetic
entries.reason: p := ADR(x) + n made the unpatched compiler panic; patch 0002 (with lit test pointer/adr_integer_arithmetic.st) makes ADR() arithmetic integer (byte) arithmetic, so the source compiles unchanged and advances n bytes

entries.name: VAR_STAT static variables
entries.reason: rejected; moved to VAR_GLOBAL under fresh names with the references of the declaring POU or method renamed (same single, once-initialized storage). VAR_STAT RETAIN/PERSISTENT stays unsupported. 2 libraries (TcUnit, TcoCore)
entries.source:
FUNCTION_BLOCK fb
VAR_STAT n : INT; END_VAR
n := n + 1;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

entries.name: VAR_INST method instance variables
entries.reason: rejected; moved to a VAR block of the owning function block under fresh names with the method's references renamed (per-instance storage, not reinitialized per call). 17 files of TwinCAT 3 libraries
entries.source:
FUNCTION_BLOCK fb
METHOD m : INT
VAR_INST n : INT; END_VAR
n := n + 1; m := n;
END_METHOD
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

entries.name: VAR_STAT RETAIN / PERSISTENT
entries.reason: retentive static variables survive a restart; the execution model has none, and var-stat-global does not apply, so the construct is reported unsupported
entries.source:
FUNCTION f : INT
VAR_STAT RETAIN n : INT; END_VAR
n := n + 1; f := n;
END_FUNCTION
